main_text.p: lavit, non evadere ex empto actionem: si modò eam rem emptor ignorauit. quia non videtur esse celatus, qui scit: neque certiorari debeat, qui non ignoravit. Sequitur aliud exemplum. Lex est: Quoties culpa debitoris intervenit, perpetuatur obligatio. Titius servum Ebutio calendis Januarijs debebat. moram aliquam, mensis forte unius, interposuit. post, eum servum offert Ebutio. hic servum accipere propter moram factam recusat. Seruus moritur. Intentio Ebutij: debes mihi servi æstimationem. D. non de-

page.notes: Handwritten annotation "aliud exemplum" in the right margin beside "Sequitur aliud" is manuscript, not printed, and was omitted. The catchword "beo." and signature "h 4" are at the foot; the catchword reading is uncertain (possibly "debeo.") and is marked for checking. The final word of the page is cut at the line end as "de-", hyphen kept. Printed "Seruus" is kept as printed; "servum" forms were normalised in u/v and i/j only.
